headline: Line 3's labeler cost us the week.
lead: Labeler jams took 412 minutes, more than any other cause. The mislabeled cases drove scrap to $18,400 and caused both customer complaints. OEE fell to 61.4%, its fifth weekly drop in a row, and we covered the gap with overtime.

category_notes.Safety: No recordables. Near-miss reports up from 4 to 7, mostly from the new walkway card. Keep it.
category_notes.Quality: Almost all the extra scrap and both complaints trace to mislabeled cases on Line 3.
category_notes.Delivery: Down 3 points to plan. Labeler jams plus 3 hours waiting on caps on Line 2.
category_notes.Cost: Saturday overtime on Line 1 and scrap pushed cost per case 32 cents over target.
category_notes.Maintenance: Unplanned downtime up 3 weeks in a row. PM compliance is recovering.
category_notes.People: Absenteeism a little over target. Watch it with the overtime.

pareto_note: Labeler jams (Line 3 only) and changeovers (all three lines) are the two to work on. Material short was one late delivery of caps.
what_changed: Line 3 switched to label stock from a second supplier on Tuesday. The jams started Tuesday night.
Scrap rose $5,300 (41%) week on week. Most of it is reworked or scrapped mislabeled cases.
OEE has fallen five weeks in a row, from 66.2% to 61.4%.
Overtime rose to 11.8% to catch up on plan, and conversion cost followed it up.

actions.title: Find out why the Line 3 labeler jams
actions.why: Start with the new label stock: run a roll from the old supplier on one shift and compare jam counts. 412 minutes and $5,300 of scrap ride on it.

actions.title: Cut time on the two longest changeovers
actions.why: Changeovers took 365 minutes across all three lines. Film the two longest, split the steps that can happen while the line runs.

actions.title: Check tomorrow's materials every afternoon
actions.why: One late cap delivery idled Line 2 for 3 hours. A 10-minute daily check of next-day materials with the supplier catches it a day early.

decisions: Approve 6 hours of planned downtime on Line 3 Saturday for the labeler fix.
Go back to the first label supplier until the trial is done?
good_news: Zero recordables, and near-miss reports up from 4 to 7.
PM compliance up 4 points to 88%, backlog inside the 2–4 week band.
